requirement: Bicycles shall be equipped with a front-facing reflector that is essentially colorless.
requirement_summary: Must have essentially colorless front reflector

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain front reflector component
Reflector performance test report per Table 1 & 2 of §1512.16

remediation: Install a front-facing essentially colorless reflector that meets §1512.16(c) performance requirements.

requirement: Bicycles shall be equipped with a rear-facing red reflector mounted on the seat post behind, with the top of the reflector at least 76mm (3in) below the intersection of the seat surface and the seat post.
requirement_summary: Must have red rear reflector on seat post, top ≥76mm below seat

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain rear red reflector component
Spec sheet must confirm rear reflector mounting position relative to seat post

remediation: Install a rear red reflector on the seat post with top at least 76mm below the seat-seat post intersection, meeting §1512.16(d) performance requirements.

requirement: Each pedal shall be equipped with reflectors on the front and rear surfaces, which shall be essentially colorless or amber.
requirement_summary: Pedals must have colorless or amber reflectors on front and rear

evidence_required.description: BOM must show pedal assemblies include reflector devices
Pedal reflector performance test report per §1512.16(e)

remediation: Equip each pedal with essentially colorless or amber reflectors on both front and rear surfaces per §1512.16(e).

requirement: Each wheel shall be equipped with side reflectors: reflective tire sidewalls, or spoke-mounted reflectors, or (for non-caliper brake) reflective rims. Front wheel reflectors shall be colorless or amber; rear wheel reflectors shall be colorless or red.
requirement_summary: Wheels must have side reflectors (tire/spoke/rim); front: colorless/amber, rear: colorless/red

evidence_required.description: BOM must contain side reflector components or reflective tires
Side reflector performance test report per §1512.16(f)

remediation: Equip each wheel with side reflectors (reflective tire sidewalls, spoke-mounted reflectors, or reflective rims) per §1512.16(b) & (f).

requirement: Sidewalk bicycles are not required to be equipped with reflectors.
requirement_summary: Sidewalk bicycles are exempt from reflector requirements

evidence_required.description: Seat height specification confirming sidewalk bicycle classification (seat height ≤ 635mm)

remediation: No action required. Sidewalk bicycles are exempt from reflector requirements per §1512.16.
